template.name: SystemQueryStats
template.description: Analyze system query usage patterns and identify most commonly used GraphQL operations
template.query: query SystemQueryStats($limit: Int = 20, $minComplexity: Int = 1, $isActive: Boolean = true) { searchTemplates(filter: { complexityMin: $minComplexity, isActive: $isActive }, limit: $limit, orderBy: "usage_count", orderDirection: "DESC") { templates { id name queryName operationType usageCount complexityScore lastUsedAt avgExecutionTimeMs } totalCount } }
